sources.title: Tripolitanian Republic
sources.note: Proclaimed 16 November 1918 (Misrata), disestablished 1922, capital 'Aziziya, territory from the Nafusa Mountains to Misrata, Italian control by 1923; no area, no campaign dates.

notes: A four-year state written from one page (the Tripolitanian Republic article) for the Italian Libya dossier's contest events. Not settled: the republic's leaders (the page names none, only later governors), the exact end (infobox 1922, 'By 1923' in the text), the Fezzan (not mentioned), and the relation to the Cyrenaican emirate (the Italian Libya dossier has the Senussi). The Italian Libya dossier records the same land as a contest zone 1918-1923 and a gain in 1923, one year after this state ends.
